name: Robe
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of robes to symbolize righteousness and salvation, as seen in Isaiah 61:10 where God clothes His people with the 'robe of righteousness.' This theme continues in Revelation, where white robes signify purity and victory for the redeemed before God's throne (Revelation 7:9, 7:13). The parable in Matthew 22:11 highlights the necessity of being properly clothed in righteousness to enter the kingdom, emphasizing the spiritual significance of the wedding garment. Together, these passages reveal that the robe represents the believer's justified standing and the transformative work of God’s salvation.
